visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a plain white t-shirt stands against a neutral, light-colored textured wall, holding a large, detailed tan silicone muscle suit with defined pectorals and abdominals in front of his torso. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the smooth texture of the muscle prop while the man maintains a neutral expression. (2) He transitions to wearing the muscle suit in a living room setting, featuring a beige modular sofa and a black-and-white patterned pillow. He poses by flexing his biceps and patting his chest, with his facial expressions shifting from neutral to a wide, confident smile. He then changes into a denim jacket outfit which has two fake, smaller hands protruding from the chest area, holding a bright yellow plastic shopping bag printed with 'CACO' branding. (3) He finally appears in a full-body Beast Titan costume, made of long, shaggy brown faux fur with a printed muscular torso area. He wears pointed ear prosthetics and stands in the same living room, making dramatic gestures with his long, fur-covered arms. The background features a tall window with thin vertical blinds and soft, natural indoor lighting. (4) A drone shot shows a large, multi-story yellow warehouse building with '中友家具' and 'CY' branding, located in an urban area with roads and nearby buildings. Inside a brightly lit, vast furniture showroom, rows of dining tables, chairs, and sofas are neatly arranged across a tiled floor. (5) The man in the beast suit lies flat on a white mattress with a patterned surface, appearing relaxed. He then shows a row of wooden closets with white and glass sliding doors, demonstrating the modular design by sliding them open. (6) He stands next to a large red and yellow prize machine with 'Time is money' text, turning a white dial and receiving a small green prize ball. He then runs through the furniture aisles in the beast suit, mimicking a giant's walk, with a small animated clip of a giant running displayed in the upper frame. (7) He stands outside the storefront waving at the camera, then transitions to sliding down a purple indoor slide in a colorful children's play area with an elephant-shaped structure.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male vocal delivering a rapid-fire introduction in Traditional Chinese. The pitch is moderately high, conveying enthusiasm. Accompanying this is an upbeat, electronic pop BGM with a steady 4/4 beat and prominent synthesized bass. Small rustling sounds occur as the character poses in his various costumes. (2) A sharp, metallic 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition. A woman’s voice is heard briefly, asking a question with a light, curious tone. The male voice immediately responds with high arousal and a wide pitch range, shouting the name of the furniture store to emphasize the destination over the consistent BGM tempo. (3) As the location shifts, the male voice adopts an animated narrative tone. He describes specific products like mattresses and closets with clear articulation. Acoustic transients include the soft percussive sound of the man lying on a bed and the mechanical sliding friction of closet doors. (4) A distinct mechanical clicking sound of a dial turning is heard, followed by the percussive 'thud' of a prize ball landing in the collection tray. The speaker's voice is triumphant as he announces the rewards. The audio concludes with a playful sound of friction on a plastic slide and a final friendly vocal sign-off over the fading electronic track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Transition -> Feature Demonstration -> Promotional Reward -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote Zhongyou Furniture in Taichung using a comedic 'boyfriend outfits' hook to grab attention before transitioning into a detailed showcase of the store's massive scale, product variety (mattresses, closets), and promotional events (gashapon prizes), positioning it as a high-value, one-stop shopping destination.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features direct brand callouts, store exterior shots, and detailed descriptions of store services and promotional prizes.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively blends social media meme culture (muscle suits, Attack on Titan references) with traditional retail advertising to reach a younger audience.
